sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ext_inject_point (c0 TEXT, c1 TEXT, c2 TEXT, c3 TEXT, c4 TEXT)

INSERT INTO ext_inject_point (c0, c1, c2, c3, c4) SELECT 'field', 'repo', (SELECT type_id FROM symbols WHERE display='Repo' AND method_id IS NULL), (SELECT type_id FROM symbols WHERE display='Consumer' AND method_id IS NULL), '-'
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ext_bean_def (c0 TEXT, c1 TEXT, c2 TEXT)
INSERT INTO ext_bean_def (c0, c1, c2) SELECT 'repo', type_id, 'bean' FROM symbols WHERE display='Repo' AND method_id IS NULL

checks.why: a bean injected into a FIELD has a visible consumer: the type that declares the field, since there is no call site
